main.description: Close all reports on a subject matching the given criteria. Reports whose current status does not permit a transition to closed are skipped silently. Intended for automated flows that resolve reports without taking action on the subject.

subject.description: Subject DID (account-level reports) or AT-URI (record-level reports) whose reports should be closed.

reportTypes.description: If specified, only reports of the given report types (fully qualified reason NSIDs) are closed. When omitted, all non-closed reports on the subject are targeted.

internalNote.description: Optional moderator-only note recorded on each close activity. Not visible to reporters.

isAutomated.description: Set true when this action is triggered by an automated process. Defaults to false.

closedCount.description: Number of reports that were transitioned to closed.

reportIds.description: IDs of the reports that were closed.
